capabilities: show file paths and extensions in tab titles
toggle leading slash in displayed paths
truncate tab titles at a configurable character limit
choose truncation join characters and path separators
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; developer installation requires npm.
intentEvidence: few related plugins but none that actually address the core issue
motivation: The author keeps many same-named files (e.g., multiple Syllabus.md files) across a vault for university course websites and found checking breadcrumbs annoying.
problem: Obsidian tabs show only the file name, so multiple files with the same name in different folders are hard to tell apart without checking breadcrumbs.

relations.evidence: this seems close to the desired outcome, but the tab title customization doesn't seem to work as expected

summary: Tab title customizer that shows file paths and extensions in editor tabs, with adjustable truncation.
